page.layout: Only handwriting, a drawn figure and show-through from the reverse; no printed block on this page.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. Top: a handwritten inscription in brown ink ("David wierdurmüllerus 16…"), which is not printed and is not transcribed. Centre: a hand-drawn cluster of overlapping circles, also not printed. The faint mirrored letters in the left and centre are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. Some stains and wear along the edges.
